title: Image-Enabled Blog Webpage
description: A user-friendly blog webpage that supports creating, publishing, and viewing blog posts with integrated image upload functionality, allowing users to enhance textual content with visual media.

features.name: Image Upload for Blog Posts
features.description: Provide an interface for users to select and upload images from their local device to include in blog posts, with support for common formats (JPG, PNG, GIF) and basic validation for file size and type to ensure compatibility.

features.name: Rich Blog Post Composition
features.description: Enable users to create blog posts that combine textual content (titles, body text) with uploaded images, allowing flexible placement of images within the post body.

features.name: Image-Embedded Post Display
features.description: Render published blog posts with properly formatted text and embedded images, ensuring images are displayed in correct dimensions and aligned appropriately within the post content.

target_users: Individual bloggers, content creators, or anyone seeking to share text-and-image-based content on a simple personal blog platform.
data_requirements: Storage for blog post metadata (titles, body text, publication dates) and uploaded image files (or references to stored images like file paths/URLs) to persist content for ongoing access.
